question: What happens to śakti for one who dissolves contraction?
premises: A practitioner may be intent on dissolving the whole mass of contraction.
When contraction dissolves, śakti can manifest freely.
inference: For one who dissolves contraction, radiant śakti freely makes whatever is desired appear within.
plain_english: Likewise, for one who is intent on dissolving the whole mass of contraction, that radiant śakti shines forth and makes whatever is desired appear within.
